whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `pip:` entry with a `git+` URL.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a `pip:` entry with a `git+` URL.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm environment.yml no longer carries a `pip:` entry with a `git+` URL.
